attributes.title: 45th Annual Winter Refresher
attributes.cme_provider: New Mexico Academy of Family Physicians
attributes.organizer: New Mexico Academy of Family Physicians
attributes.summary:
AAFP has reviewed this single-day program for up to 7 Live Prescribed credits, a useful number if you need a quick top-up. The 2027 agenda covers pediatric sports concussion, obesity medicine beyond surgery, billing and coding, personality disorders in primary care, transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis and in-flight medical emergencies.

A $229 room rate holds until January 18, 2027. Registration fees were not visible on the public page when we checked.
